description: Translation-shim adapters that present the OpenAI-compatible ChatProvider contract while speaking each provider's native wire format: Anthropic Messages API (P2.7), Google Gemini generateContent (P2.8), and AWS Bedrock SigV4 (P2.9). Each translates request in, normalizes streamed/non-streamed responses out. Depends on FEAT-001; the three shims are mutually independent and independent of FEAT-002. Tests use mocked HTTP + SSE/event-stream fixtures only (no live network); providers crate compile/test/clippy DEFERRED TO CI.
steps: Implement P2.7 Anthropic in crates/providers/src/adapters/anthropic.rs (ProviderKind::Anthropic): translate the internal ChatRequest to the Messages API (POST {base_url}/v1/messages, base_url default https://api.anthropic.com, headers `x-api-key: <key>` + `anthropic-version`). Split any system-role message(s) out to the top-level `system` field; map user/assistant/tool roles into the Anthropic messages array; map internal ToolSpec function schemas to Anthropic `tools`. Normalize the Anthropic SSE event stream (content_block_delta etc.) back into internal ChatDelta values, and the non-streaming response into ChatResponse. Provide its ProviderFactory. capabilities(model) reports tools+streaming true, vision per model.

Implement P2.8 Gemini in crates/providers/src/adapters/gemini.rs (ProviderKind::Gemini): translate ChatRequest -> Gemini generateContent / streamGenerateContent bodies: map messages to `contents` with `parts`, map internal ToolSpec to `functionDeclarations` under `tools`, map system prompt to systemInstruction. Key/auth per config (API key as query param `?key=` or header per Gemini convention); read extra.project if present. Normalize streamed chunks (candidates[].content.parts[].text and functionCall) back into ChatDelta and the non-streaming response into ChatResponse. Provide its ProviderFactory.

Implement P2.9 Bedrock in crates/providers/src/adapters/bedrock.rs (ProviderKind::Bedrock): SigV4-sign requests to the Bedrock Runtime endpoint (region via extra.region), do per-model body shaping (e.g. Anthropic-on-Bedrock vs Titan bodies) selected by the model id, and normalize the Bedrock event stream into ChatDelta / the non-streaming response into ChatResponse. CREDENTIALS: per architecture.md Section 4.3, AWS access keys entered in-app are stored as a SecretRef and resolved through the keystore at call time (primary path); ALSO allow the standard AWS credential provider chain (env/shared config/instance role) as an optional secondary path when no SecretRef is configured. Raw credentials never cross IPC. Provide its ProviderFactory.

For each shim add unit/integration tests using mocked HTTP + fixture response bodies (wiremock/httpmock): assert (a) request TRANSLATION - the outbound native body/headers/path are correct (Anthropic: system split out, roles+tools mapped, x-api-key+anthropic-version headers; Gemini: contents/parts + functionDeclarations + key placement; Bedrock: correct per-model body shape and a valid SigV4 Authorization header is produced deterministically from a fixed test credential+region+time), and (b) stream NORMALIZATION - fixture native SSE/event-stream frames decode into ordered internal ChatDelta values, non-streaming into ChatResponse. For Bedrock SigV4, test signing with fixed inputs so the signature is deterministic and asserted; do NOT call AWS. No live network anywhere.

Add a Bedrock credential-resolution test proving the SecretRef/keystore path is used when configured (via InMemorySecretStore) and that the AWS-provider-chain fallback path is selected when no SecretRef is present (mock/stub the chain; do not require real AWS env).

Update crates/providers/src/lib.rs adapter exports; remove satisfied #[allow(dead_code)] placeholders. Run `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml`. Re-run offline `cargo build/test/clippy --workspace` to confirm offline members remain green (providers itself compiles only in CI).
acceptance_criteria: anthropic.rs, gemini.rs, bedrock.rs each provide a ChatProvider impl + ProviderFactory presenting the internal OpenAI-compatible contract while translating to their native wire format.
Anthropic splits system prompt to top-level `system`, maps roles + tool schemas, uses x-api-key + anthropic-version, normalizes SSE deltas.
Gemini maps messages to contents/parts and tools to functionDeclarations, normalizes streamed chunks.

Bedrock performs SigV4 signing (region via extra.region), per-model body shaping, event-stream normalization; resolves AWS creds via SecretRef/keystore (primary) with AWS provider-chain as optional secondary path; no raw creds cross IPC.
Mocked-HTTP tests assert request translation and stream normalization for all three shims, with deterministic SigV4 signing asserted from fixed inputs; no live network.
Offline `cargo build/test/clippy --workspace` remain green; `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml --check` clean.
verification: From hybrid-orchestrator/: `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (offline members)
Review confirms shims present the OpenAI-compatible contract, tests use mocked HTTP/event-stream fixtures with deterministic SigV4; providers crate compile/test/clippy deferred to CI.
findings:
Implemented the three translation-shim adapters, each presenting the internal OpenAI-compatible ChatProvider contract while translating to a native wire format, plus a ProviderFactory per module (re-exported from lib.rs as AnthropicFactory/GeminiFactory/BedrockFactory).

P2.7 Anthropic (adapters/anthropic.rs): POST {base_url}/v1/messages (default https://api.anthropic.com) with x-api-key + anthropic-version headers (version overridable via extra.anthropic_version, default 2023-06-01). Splits system-role message(s) to the top-level `system` field; maps user/assistant/tool roles into the Anthropic messages array (assistant tool_calls -> tool_use blocks with arguments parsed from the internal JSON string to an object; tool role -> user message with a tool_result block); maps internal ToolSpec -> Anthropic tools {name,description,input_schema}; supplies required max_tokens default 4096. Non-streaming response normalized (text + tool_use + usage + stop_reason). SSE normalization handles content_block_start (tool_use id/name), content_block_delta text_delta + input_json_delta fragments, and message_delta stop_reason via the shared sse_event_stream decoder. capabilities: streaming+tools true, vision on for claude-3/claude-4.

P2.8 Gemini (adapters/gemini.rs): POST {base_url}/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent (and :streamGenerateContent?alt=sse for streaming), default base https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com, API key placed on the query string (?key=). Maps messages to contents/parts (assistant role -> `model`, tool -> functionResponse part); system prompt -> systemInstruction; ToolSpec -> tools[0].functionDeclarations; temperature/max_tokens -> generationConfig (maxOutputTokens). extra.project is read and retained (scoped #[allow(dead_code)] with an OAuth-in-Phase-3 note). Non-streaming + streamed chunk normalization for candidates[].content.parts[] text and functionCall. camelCase serde on all Gemini response structs.

P2.9 Bedrock (adapters/bedrock.rs): SigV4-signs requests to the Bedrock Runtime endpoint (region via extra.region; default host bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com), path /model/{model}/invoke or /invoke-with-response-stream. Per-model body shaping via ModelFamily::from_model_id: Anthropic-on-Bedrock (anthropic_version=bedrock-2023-05-31 + messages + max_tokens + system) vs Amazon Titan (inputText + textGenerationConfig). AWS event-stream binary framing decoded by decode_event_stream (prelude/headers-len/payload/CRC layout; CRCs unchecked, lengths validated) plus a dependency-free base64 decoder for the inner chunk `bytes`; inner payloads normalized per family into ChatDelta. Credentials: resolve_credentials uses the SecretRef/keystore path as PRIMARY when api_key_ref is set (keystore holds a JSON blob {access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token?}), and the AWS provider chain (env vars entry point) as the SECONDARY path when no api_key_ref; CredentialSource enum records which path was taken; raw creds never cross IPC. sign_request is a pure fn of (creds, region, method, url, body, time) so signing is deterministic.

Tests (all mocked HTTP / fixtures, no live network): Anthropic + Gemini use wiremock MockServer asserting outbound translation (system split-out, roles+tools mapping, x-api-key/anthropic-version headers; Gemini contents/parts + functionDeclarations + ?key= placement) and SSE stream normalization into ordered ChatDelta. Bedrock: deterministic SigV4 assertion from fixed credential (AKIDEXAMPLE) + region us-east-1 + fixed instant (20150830T123600Z) checking the Authorization scope/credential/signed-headers and that re-signing identical inputs reproduces the same 64-hex signature; per-model body-shape tests; event-stream decode+normalize test with hand-built frames; credential-resolution tests proving SecretRef path is used when configured (InMemorySecretStore) and ProviderChain fallback is selected when no SecretRef (env entry point stubbed with fixed values); a wiremock test that chat() sends a signed request (authorization + x-amz-date present) and normalizes the response.

VERIFIED OFFLINE: `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml --check` clean; from hybrid-orchestrator/ `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` all green (offline members; providers is under [workspace] exclude so bare workspace commands do not build it).

DEFERRED TO CI (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: crates.io returns 403, confirmed): the providers crate's own build/test/clippy run only in CI via the existing `--manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml` steps (ubuntu + windows). No new runtime deps were added to crates/providers/Cargo.toml (aws-sigv4 1 and aws-credential-types 1 were already present from FEAT-001; the base64 + event-stream framing are hand-rolled, so no aws-smithy-eventstream dep needed). CI is the first place this code compiles; the aws-sigv4 1.x usage (v4::SigningParams::builder().identity(&Identity).region().name().time().settings().build().into(); http_request::{sign, SignableRequest, SignableBody, SigningSettings}; SigningInstructions::headers()) follows the documented 1.x example API and should compile first-try, but is validated by CI.

=== V1 REVIEW REMEDIATION (2026-09-06-173034-review.md) ===
Addressed the review's NEEDS_CHANGES issues in the shim adapters (all offline-verifiable checks re-run green; providers compile still deferred to CI).

Issue 1 (Gemini streaming tool-calls) FIXED: parse_stream_chunk was renamed to parse_stream_chunk_with(data, &mut next_tool_index) and now assigns each streamed functionCall a PROCESS-MONOTONIC index/id (call_{index}) threaded across chunks, instead of restarting at i=0 per chunk. chat_stream threads the counter through the post_sse `Fn` closure via an Arc<AtomicU32> (the SSE state machine polls frames sequentially, so Relaxed ordering is sufficient). Documented the streaming convention in a fn doc comment: Gemini delivers each functionCall as a COMPLETE object, so arguments_fragment carries the whole args JSON and, because the index is unique per call, an index-keyed accumulator yields exactly one terminal fragment per call and can never concatenate two complete JSON blobs or collide ids. Added regression test chat_stream_multi_tool_calls_get_distinct_indices (two calls in two chunks -> indices 0 and 1, ids call_0/call_1, distinct complete arg blobs); this FAILS under the old code.

Issue 5 (Gemini tool-result functionResponse.name) FIXED: build_body now builds an id->function-name map from assistant tool_calls first, then a Tool message resolves functionResponse.name from the correlating call via tool_call_id (falling back to msg.name, then to the raw tool_call_id) instead of the previously-empty msg.name. Added tests build_body_tool_result_name_from_correlating_call and build_body_tool_result_falls_back_to_tool_call_id.

Issue 6 (Gemini API key on URL) FIXED: the key now travels in the x-goog-api-key HEADER (request_headers) instead of the ?key= query string, keeping it off the URL (the most log-prone surface, incl. reqwest transport errors that stringify the URL). path()/list_models updated; module + fn docs updated; tests updated (path_omits_key_and_header_carries_it; chat test matches on the header and asserts the key does not appear on req.url).

Issue 2 (Bedrock advertises tools but drops them) FIXED (chosen: make caps honest): caps_for now returns tools:false for Bedrock (with a comment explaining tool mapping is not wired for Bedrock in Phase 2 and that the direct Anthropic adapter is unaffected), so capability negotiation strips tools rather than routing a tool request into a silent drop.

Issue 3 (Bedrock chat_stream buffered) FIXED (chosen: incremental): added decode_one_frame (single-frame primitive returning Ok(None) when the buffer lacks a complete frame) shared by decode_event_stream and a new bedrock_event_stream() that de-frames INCREMENTALLY off resp.bytes_stream() via futures unfold, emitting each frame's ChatDelta as its bytes arrive and retaining partial trailing bytes. chat_stream now returns that stream. Added test chat_stream_incremental_across_split_chunks (frames split mid-frame across three byte chunks still decode in order).

Issue 8 (Bedrock Titan prompt tokens) FIXED: TitanBody now reads top-level inputTextTokenCount and normalize_titan populates prompt_tokens from it (total_tokens = prompt+completion). Added test normalize_titan_populates_prompt_tokens.

Issue 7 (Anthropic user message text-only) DOCUMENTED-AS-ACCEPTABLE: added a comment on the MessageRole::User arm noting Phase 2 user messages are text-only and that caps vision:true advertises future capability, not working image input yet (multimodal plumbing is a later phase). No behavior change (the internal ChatMessage has no image field yet).

Issue 9 (negotiate streaming_fallback advisory) DOCUMENTED-AS-ACCEPTABLE: added a note on Negotiated.streaming_fallback (capability.rs) that the flag is advisory in Phase 2 and the session manager must honor it in a later phase. No behavior change.

Issue 4 (first-compile API risk) DEFERRED-TO-CI (cannot fix offline): crates.io 403 confirmed again; re-read the touched API usages for 1.x/0.12 correctness. reqwest 0.12 bytes_stream() + StreamExt::map/.boxed() mirror the existing capability.rs post_sse pattern; futures unfold state-machine mirrors the existing sse_event_stream. No aws-sigv4 API was changed by this remediation. CI (ubuntu+windows) is the compile gate.

No serde/DTO shapes changed by this remediation (Gemini/Bedrock changes are internal wire translation, header-vs-query, and capability VALUES; ToolCallDelta/Capabilities shapes unchanged), so frontend/src/types/index.ts needed no update. Re-verified offline: cargo fmt --check (providers) clean; cargo build/test/clippy --workspace green.
